<a id="summary"></a>

## Summary

A role records the harness, model and effort its holder runs on (the existing `default_seat`) and the parameters it needs filled at start, each required or optional. Filling them refuses an unknown name and names every missing required one.

<a id="goals"></a>

## Goals

- A role says how to launch its holder and what it needs to start.

<a id="non-goals"></a>

## Non-goals

- Starting a seat (plan 242) and the first turn (plan 241).

<a id="execution-guardrails"></a>

## Execution Guardrails

- Cost: on demand only: add and edit are the writer's usual commit; filling is in-process. No loop, poll or timer.
- No permission rule changes (PRD 003); no daemon enforcement of a type's rules; no existing JSON field removed or renamed.
- Builds nice-19 through `just shared-build`, one at a time.
